features.name: url_length
features.description: Total length of the cleaned URL in characters

features.name: hostname_length
features.description: Character count of the fully qualified domain name

features.name: path_length
features.description: Character count of the URL path

features.name: query_length
features.description: Length of the query string following '?'

features.name: fragment_length
features.description: Length of the fragment identifier following '#'

features.name: count_dots
features.description: Number of dot '.' characters in the URL

features.name: count_hyphens
features.description: Number of hyphen '-' characters in the URL

features.name: count_underscores
features.description: Number of underscore '_' characters in the URL

features.name: count_slashes
features.description: Number of forward slash '/' characters in the URL

features.name: count_question_marks
features.description: Number of question mark '?' delimiters

features.name: count_equals
features.description: Number of '=' characters in URL query string

features.name: count_ampersands
features.description: Number of '&' parameter delimiters

features.name: count_percent
features.description: Number of percent '%' hex encoding tokens

features.name: count_digits
features.description: Total number of numeric digits in URL

features.name: count_letters
features.description: Total number of alphabetic characters in URL

features.name: count_special_chars
features.description: Non-alphanumeric character count excluding path/protocol

features.name: ratio_digits_url
features.description: Ratio of digits to total URL length

features.name: ratio_special_chars

features.name: count_subdomains
features.description: Number of subdomain labels prior to registered domain

features.description: Binary flag indicating whether hostname is a raw IPv4/IPv6

features.description: Binary flag indicating known URL shortening domain

features.name: has_https
features.description: Binary flag indicating whether protocol scheme is HTTPS

features.name: suspicious_keyword_count
features.description: Count of matched credential harvesting keywords in URL

features.name: hostname_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy score of the hostname string

features.description: Shannon entropy score of the complete URL string

features.name: path_token_count
features.description: Count of path segments delimited by '/'

features.name: query_param_count
features.description: Number of distinct key-value query parameters

features.name: is_suspicious_tld
features.description: Binary indicator for top-level domains with high abuse rates

features.name: has_punycode
features.description: Binary flag for internationalized domain homograph (xn--)

features.name: has_encoded_chars
features.description: Binary flag indicating URL percent-encoded characters

features.name: hostname_path_ratio
features.description: Ratio of hostname length to path length

features.name: repeated_char_max
